verdict.rationale: Floot's project checkpoints give coarse versioning and rollback: create_checkpoint labels a revert point in the Checkpoint panel, and the assistant can restore a checkpoint. Scheduled jobs are part of the project, so they are covered by these project-wide snapshots, not versioned individually. Missing for 10: per-automation version history, any review or diff of changes before or after applying them, and independent or hands-on confirmation that rollback works.
